answer: The grove register is checked at draw time, falcon lists the eligible set, and tide seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 39 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 39 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. A 64 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
